evidence: RESOLVED: round-1 MAJOR paraphrase-active-reader. Query is now 'What preserves an obsolete search view while an ongoing lookup is still using it?'. cache_v3.generation_reader leases the active generation and _collect_garbage retains a generation whose reader-lease count is > 0, so palimnex/cache_v3.py still answers the same lease-protection behaviour. No identifier, lowercase trigram, or distinctive two-word phrase from that file remains in the query.

RESOLVED: round-1 MAJOR paraphrase-portable-rescan. Query is now 'What screens stored user content again before a protected archive crosses between machines?'. portable._rescan_portable_content still runs from export_pack and validate_pack, so palimnex/portable.py still answers the same rescan-at-pack-boundary behaviour. The copied docstring phrase 'variable payload' is gone.

RESOLVED: round-1 MAJOR synonym-tamper-evident-record. Query is now 'How is a signed historical milestone compared with a separately retained reference?'. integrity.create_checkpoint/verify_checkpoint sign a checkpoint and verify_history compares the tip to expected_tip, so palimnex/integrity.py still answers the same behaviour. The copied error phrase 'external trust anchor' is gone.

RESOLVED: round-1 MAJOR synonym-secret-detector. Query is now 'What blocks leaked authentication material yet discloses just a category and source position?'. security.ContentFinding exposes only rule and line, and scan_text never returns the matched value, so palimnex/security.py still answers the same behaviour. The copied docstring phrase 'the matched value' is gone.
RESOLVED: round-1 NOTE openai-key. Amendment A1 renamed canary_rule, the schema enum and CANARY_RULES to openai-token, matching security.py rule name openai-token.

RESOLVED: round-1 MINOR missing isolation test. test_paraphrase_and_synonym_queries_are_source_isolated now asserts that every paraphrase and synonym query shares no identifier-shaped token and no lowercase trigram with its expected file; the test passed.

NOTE: palimnex.tests.test_semantic_cohort 11/11 passed including the A2 isolation test; palimnex.tests.test_ontology_shadow_cohort 6/6 passed; implementation-receipt validator status valid. Raw cohort bytes have zero security.scan_bytes findings.

NOTE: Fix round 1 also rewrote synonym-sealed-archive (dropped portable.py 'durable history') and synonym-database-upgrade (dropped migrations.py 'one step'). Both still ask the same behaviour: validate_pack authenticates an encrypted pack before import/export, and migrations.resolve_step/plan/apply validate the immediate successor before the replacement guard. Expected paths unchanged and source-defensible.

NOTE: Independent A2 re-check of all 14 paraphrase/synonym queries found no shared identifier-shaped tokens and no shared lowercase trigrams. The only remaining two-word overlaps are generic English in paraphrase-interrupted-format-change ('an interrupted', 'on the') against migrations.py recovery text, not distinctive docstring, error or name collocations.
